awakening.name: Solemn Lament

[Unfocused Volley]
When inflicting [Butterfly] using this Skill's effects: (Chance to flip Heads)% chance to inflict The Departed. If this unit did not inflict The Departed, inflict The Living instead. (calculates every [Butterfly] Stack independently)

- [Before Attack] Gain a random assortment of (Gloom Reson. + 1) [The Living & The Departed] (max 7)
- [Attack End] [Reload (Solemn Lament)]
